title: Players
switcherHint: Calendar, practices and analytics follow the selected player.
noActivePlayer: You don't have an active player yet.

roster.lastPractice: {days, plural, =0 {Practiced today} =1 {Practiced yesterday} other {# days without a practice}}
roster.noRecentPractice: No practice in the last {days} days

limit.reached: You've reached the number of active players your plan allows. Archive one to make room for another.
limit.exceeded: That is more than your plan allows, so practices cannot be logged. Archive {excess, plural, one {# player} other {# players}} to start again.

addForm.heading: Add player
addForm.nameHint: A first name or nickname is enough — no full name required.

share.heading: Share access
share.description: Generate a code and send it to the player, parent, or manager (SMS, WhatsApp...). They enter it once in their own app and will see this player's practices and analytics.
share.pendingStatus: Waiting for the code to be entered

link.heading: Link with another coach
link.ownerDescription: Generate a code and send it to the player's coach in the other discipline. They enter it once and will see this player's practices in their calendar, read-only. You keep full control — stop the link any time and they lose access.
link.viewerDescription: Enter the code you got from the player's coach in the other discipline. Their practices will show up in your calendar, read-only — you can see them, but not change them.
link.pendingStatus: Waiting for the code to be entered
link.summaryLabel: Show them a summary of my work
link.summaryHint: They'll see only how this player's minutes split across focus areas — no drill codes and no notes. Turn it off any time.
link.summaryOwnerHint: If they choose to share back, a summary of their work shows at the bottom of your analytics.

errors.invalidBirthYear: Enter a valid year of birth.
errors.playerLimitReached: You've reached the number of active players your plan allows. Archive a player first, or move up to a higher plan.
errors.linkInvalidCode: That code is invalid or has already been used.
errors.linkSameDiscipline: That code is from a coach of the same discipline. Links connect a player's tennis card with their fitness card.
errors.linkSamePlayer: That code belongs to this player's own card.
errors.linkNotYourPlayer: You can only link your own player.
errors.linkNotInOrganization: In a federation, players are assigned by the head coach — no code is needed.
errors.linkAlreadyLinked: These two cards are already linked the other way round. To share back, the coach who entered your code turns on the summary on that link.
